data.statement: Append-only evidence correction: evt-20260905-v10-shark-mug-preflight cited only the candidate-created event, which did not itself contain the Amazon availability, price, image-hash, or canonical-page response. The new candidate-specific verification receipt and JSON artifact now durably support those unchanged claims and the downstream selection learning.
data.decision: Treat evt-20260905-v10-shark-mug-verification-receipt as the supporting evidence event for the preflight and downstream candidate learning; preserve the original events unchanged under the append-only policy.
data.nextAction: Future product preflights should record a candidate-specific verification receipt before citing availability, price, image, and canonical-page claims.
